_comment: Region profiles (plan-region-primitive.md D2/D12/C3). A profile is a named bag of CLIENT-SIDE presentation properties a zone region points at by name; the server never reads any of it. This file is the single source of truth: the client imports it, and tools/tiled/generate-palette.mjs reads it to build Tiled's AuraProfile dropdown, so a profile added here is offerable in the editor without anyone maintaining a second list. A profile that omits a property is TRANSPARENT to it (D0): the next containing region answers, and failing that the shipped default.
_comment_colors: Colours are ground fill, drawn under the terrain blobs. ⚑ Every value here is [PLACEHOLDER] and safe to change forever - it is data, not code, and no test pins any of it. NAMES are the only mildly sticky part: a region in api/zones/*.json names its profile, so a rename means fixing every region that names it.
_comment_c3: The set was ruled 2026-08-25 (C3, the D16 look sitting): 8 families x 2, base + variation, in authored order because that is the order the Tiled dropdown offers. ⭐ EVERY profile is intended to carry a TEXTURE eventually (C3 ruling) - these colours are then D14's fallback and D11's default, not the shipped look. ⚑ A profile is a MATERIAL, not a place: many separate forests share `Forest`, which is why a quest-addressable area cannot be a profile name (§11).
